teachingQuestion: Where does security enter and re-enter the software lifecycle?
focalInsight: Security feedback must flow from requirements through production and back into the next change.
title: Secure SDLC feedback loop
caption: Security is continuous across build, release, operation, and retirement.
altSummary: A six-stage loop connects requirements, design, build, testing, operation, and retirement, with operational learning feeding future requirements.
textFallback: Start with security and privacy requirements and a threat model. Design boundaries and controls, then build with secure standards, review, and dependency provenance. Test code, interfaces, abuse cases, and configurations before release. Operate with logging, patching, vulnerability response, and incident learning. Retire by revoking access, handling data and secrets, and preserving required evidence; lessons feed the next requirements cycle.
